restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตแพทย์สายไหม (คลินิกฟันสวย)
text:
I had my teeth scaled and it was a great experience. The dentist was very gentle and professional, and explained every step clearly. I also received helpful advice on how to take better care of my oral health.

For the teeth that have some issues, the dentist carefully checked them and recommended getting dental crowns. The explanation was clear, including the reasons, benefits, and treatment options, which made me feel confident about the decision.

Although there are only a few staff members, the service was still excellent and well-organized. Overall, I’m very impressed with the service. The clinic is clean, the staff are friendly, and the care is excellent. Highly recommended for anyone looking for dental scaling and professional dental care!
